hospitals.description: The state's public academic children's hospital sits inside UNC Medical Center on the UNC-Chapel Hill campus, sharing a building complex with the N.C. Women's, N.C. Cancer and neurosciences hospitals. It cares for patients from birth to age 21 from every corner of North Carolina, with 158 beds that include a 20-bed PICU and a 58-bed Newborn Critical Care Center. It is one of only three Level I pediatric trauma centers in the state, so the acuity mix is high and transfers arrive from community hospitals across central and eastern NC. The campus is a short drive from Durham and about 30 minutes from Raleigh, in a college town with strong schools and a walkable downtown.
highlights: 158 pediatric beds; 20-bed PICU; 58-bed Newborn Critical Care Center
Level I pediatric trauma center, one of three in North Carolina
Teaching hospital of the UNC School of Medicine
Parent UNC Medical Center has roughly 916 to 932 beds and is a Level I adult trauma center
Closest major children's hospital to family in Chapel Hill

hospitals.description: Duke's children's hospital occupies part of the Duke University Hospital campus on Erwin Road in Durham, next to the university's West Campus and the Duke medical and nursing schools. It has about 151 beds and includes both a pediatric ICU and a neonatal ICU, serving as a quaternary referral center for children from across the Southeast. The parent hospital opened in 1930, is a Level I trauma center with more than 1,000 beds, and was named the best hospital in North Carolina by U.S. News in 2024. Durham is a mid-sized, fast-growing city about 15 minutes from Chapel Hill and 25 minutes from Raleigh.

hospitals.description: WakeMed's children's hospital is part of the system's flagship Raleigh campus on New Bern Avenue, east of downtown Raleigh. The campus runs two separate 24-hour emergency departments, one of them only for children, plus a children's intensive care unit and a Level IV neonatal ICU with a 48-bed nursery. The Raleigh campus is a Level I trauma center and the busiest acute care site in Wake County, so pediatric volume is large and growing with the county. WakeMed is a private not-for-profit system that started as Memorial Hospital of Wake County in 1961.

hospitals.description: UNC Rex is the oldest hospital in Raleigh and the largest community hospital in the Triangle, a campus of roughly 489 beds on Lake Boone Trail between downtown, Cary and RDU airport. Rex was the first Magnet-designated hospital in the Triangle and is owned by UNC Health.

hospitals.description: Atrium Health Cabarrus is a roughly 450-bed teaching hospital in Concord, northeast of Charlotte, and home to the Jeff Gordon Children's Center, which opened in December 2006 with support from the NASCAR driver's foundation. The children's program offers neonatal intensive care, pediatric surgery and endoscopy, the region's only pediatric epilepsy monitoring unit, child life, a pediatric transport team and a children's advocacy center, and it links to Levine Children's for higher-level care. The hospital is a Level III trauma center and was an early Magnet hospital. Concord and Cabarrus County are fast-growing suburbs with lower costs than Charlotte.
highlights: About 447 to 457 beds; Level III trauma center
Jeff Gordon Children's Center opened December 2006
Region's only pediatric epilepsy monitoring unit
Neonatal intensive care and pediatric transport team
Magnet since 2002
hospitals.notes: Kept as a parent record (per the earlier plan) with the Jeff Gordon Children's Center described here; job postings use the label 'Levine Children's Jeff Gordon Children's Hospital'. The Atrium page (read 2026-10-20) lists neonatal intensive care but no level, no PICU and no pediatric ED, so those flags are unset. peds_inpatient true is from the children's hospital framing and PQCNC listing 'Jeff Gordon Children's Hospital at Atrium Health'; verify bed count.

hospitals.description: Novant Health Huntersville Medical Center is a 151-bed hospital serving north Mecklenburg County and the Lake Norman towns of Huntersville, Cornelius and Davidson. It opened in 2004 and offers emergency, surgical, intensive care and maternity services, with a labor and delivery unit described on Novant's site. There is no dedicated pediatric unit; children needing admission go to Hemby Children's in Charlotte. The Lake Norman area is suburban and popular with young families.
highlights: 151 beds
Maternity and labor and delivery services
Serves the Lake Norman suburbs

hospitals.description: Novant Health Matthews Medical Center is a roughly 154-bed hospital in the southeast Charlotte suburb of Matthews, serving Matthews, Mint Hill and western Union County. It provides emergency, surgical, intensive care and women's services and recently finished a reported $170 million expansion. Local TV reported on a new Level III NICU at the hospital, which makes it a possible neonatal NP site. There is no general pediatric inpatient unit known; admitted children go to Hemby Children's.
